records.text: First preserve the movement pattern and training intent, not just the muscle label.
Then check equipment, skill, range tolerance, pain/limitations, stability, loading potential and user preference.
Prefer a close substitute: barbell squat → hack squat or leg press; bench press → machine chest press; RDL → cable pull-through or hip-extension pattern.
If pain is reported, do not automatically prescribe a workaround. Ask about symptoms and recommend appropriate assessment when indicated.
